text:
Sana: FYI release cut is blocked, deploy-bot is stuck trying to promote the canary image to prod.
Sana: CI is failing in the final artifact step — looks like cache/untar symlink errors across several runners.
Sana: @ops-jen are you oncall? we have a change window and need a decision on pin vs wait.
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt 3 -> stalled. Reason: lease_acquire_timeout on artifact-indexer (500ms retries exhausted).
deploy-bot: Logs: `error=lease_acquire_timeout` `artifact=img.redwood/repo:canary-202603` 
Kevin: I see the same failures in buildkite: many agents fail during `tar -xzf` with symlink permission errors.
Kevin: snippet from a failing job:
```
+ tar -xzf artifacts.tgz
tar: symlink 'venv/bin' -> '../venv': Cannot create symlink
ERROR: artifact extraction failed
```
Julia: This smells like an NFS permissions/symlink handling regression on the cache host after the recent kernel update.
Julia: We can either wait for infra to roll back the kernel or pin to the last good image. Which is higher priority? :alarm_clock:
Mike: Customer-facing release scheduled in 35 minutes. I'd vote pin & manual promote to avoid missing the window.
Mike: We can follow up with a hotfix for the cache host in the next maintenance window.
ops-jen: Oncall here. Confirmed multiple cache restore failures across eu-west runners. I've seen the kernel bump earlier today.
ops-jen: Rolling back kernel across runners will take ~20-25m and is risky during the window. Recommend manual promote.
Sana: Manual promote plan: promote last-green sha and document rollback reasoning in release notes. Who can run manual promote and call it out in release notes?
Kevin: I can run manual promote. Command I'll use:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:8a7f6d --env prod --reason "manual-promote-due-to-cache-flake"
```
Julia: Add a follow-up task to infra to revert kernel or change mount options, and link the failing jobs so QA can validate later.
ops-jen: I'll open infra ticket: INFRA-2026. Add logs and failing job ids.
deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested by Kevin. Awaiting operator confirmation.
Kevin: Running manual promote now.
Kevin: /deploy promote --image sha:8a7f6d --env prod --reason "manual-promote-due-to-cache-flake"
deploy-bot: Promotion started. rolling -> prod replicas. :arrow_forward:
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. new prod image sha:8a7f6d. Health checks: OK. :white_check_mark:
Sana: Thanks team. Shipping to prod. Please update release notes with the pin & incident link.
Mike: I'll update release notes: "Pinned to sha:8a7f6d due to CI artifact extraction failures caused by cache host kernel update; infra follow-up INFRA-2026." 
Julia: Also add a test to the release checklist to validate artifact extraction from cache hosts post-kernel updates.
ops-jen: INFRA ticket created: INFRA-2026. Notes attached, cluster/host list, failing job ids: bk/1234,bk/1256,bk/1299.
Sana: Postmortem: short follow up after release. For now we meet the cut window.
Mike: Nice swift call. :rocket:
Kevin: Filing a small PR to docs with the exact rollback command used and the decision rationale.
Sana: Closing thread after follow-ups are tracked. Thanks everyone.
__notes: thread documents must be single continuous string of messages; messages are in chronological order and prefixed with sender name
